selected_findings.title: Fence overlapping settings reads against completed saves
selected_findings.why_it_matters: The administrator can see the old global limits and old saved revision after successfully saving new values. Click refresh while a preview is ready, then save: the refresh GET can capture revision 0, the PATCH and its follow-up GET can render revision 1, and the delayed first GET then unconditionally replaces the form with revision 0. A subsequent preview submits both mutable values from that stale form, potentially restoring an old limit when the administrator only intended to change the other field.
